tasks.label: Summarizer
tasks.description: Condense long text into key points.
tasks.placeholder: Paste an article, notes or paragraph to summarize...
tasks.system: You are a careful academic assistant. You summarize text faithfully and never add facts that are not in the source.
tasks.template:
Summarize the text below.
Rules:
1. Give exactly {points} bullet points.
2. Each bullet must be under 25 words.
3. Use only information present in the text.
4. Finish with one line starting 'Takeaway:'.
Tone: {tone}.

TEXT:
{input}

tasks.label: Idea Generator
tasks.description: Brainstorm project, startup or content ideas.
tasks.placeholder: e.g. Mini project ideas for a third-year CSE student using machine learning
tasks.system: You are a creative but practical brainstorming partner for engineering students.
tasks.template:
Generate {points} distinct ideas for the topic below.
For each idea give: a short title, a one-line description, and one difficulty tag (Easy / Medium / Hard).
Keep ideas realistic for a student team to build in 4 weeks.
Tone: {tone}.

TOPIC:
{input}

tasks.label: Concept Explainer
tasks.system: You are a patient teacher who explains technical topics to undergraduate students.
tasks.template:
Explain the concept below to a second-year engineering student.
Structure your answer as: (a) one-sentence definition, (b) a real-life analogy, (c) a short example, (d) one common misconception.
Keep it under 200 words. Tone: {tone}.

CONCEPT:
{input}

tasks.label: Email Writer
tasks.description: Draft a clear, polite professional email.
tasks.placeholder: e.g. Ask my professor for a 2-day extension on the lab report because of illness
tasks.system: You write clear, polite and concise professional emails for students.
tasks.template:
Write an email based on the request below.
Include a subject line, greeting, body (max {points} short sentences) and a sign-off with the placeholder [Your Name].
Tone: {tone}.

REQUEST:
{input}

tasks.label: Text Generator
tasks.description: Generate a short paragraph, post or note on any topic.
tasks.placeholder: e.g. A short LinkedIn post about finishing my first AI project
tasks.system: You are a helpful writing assistant. Write original, clear text and do not invent statistics or quotes.
tasks.template:
Write a short piece of text on the topic below in about {points} sentences.
Avoid made-up statistics, names or quotations.
Tone: {tone}.

TOPIC:
{input}
